page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare metal server instance powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors. The system features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, operating without hyperthreading to ensure consistent compute performance per core. It is equipped with 384 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4 GB of RAM per core.

The instance integrates hardware acceleration via four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and storage volumes.

From a resource density perspective, this bare metal configuration offers high compute and GPU density, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient platform for workloads that require dedicated hardware access without hypervisor overhead. The combination of 96 dedicated cores and multiple NVIDIA T4 GPUs makes this server suitable for parallel processing tasks, machine learning inference, video transcoding, and distributed database workloads that leverage GPU acceleration.
